title: Infra Timelapse ports, logistics nodes, corridors, and chokepoints

source_issue.purpose: Initial monitoring universe defined in issue #1

notes: Every coordinates array is [longitude, latitude]; gps objects repeat the same values as named fields.
Port and terminal coordinates identify the facility, port area, or proposed site, as indicated by coordinate_precision.
Corridor paths are schematic monitoring waypoints, not surveyed rail, road, shipping, or pipeline alignments.
Combined issue entries are split into individual assets so each monitored location has one GPS point.
Planned, proposed, delayed, and dual-use assets are retained because they are explicitly in issue #1.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap contributors via Nominatim and Overpass
sources.use: Facility, terminal, station, and planned-site coordinates
